summary: Review SaaS pricing pages as commercial decision systems rather than isolated copy.

must_inspect.why: Buyers must be able to understand why plans differ and which constraint changes the decision.
false_positive_guards: Do not call deliberate simplification ambiguous if detailed terms are available before commitment.

must_inspect.why: Price should be connected to a concrete value mechanism or cost avoided at the relevant decision cost.
false_positive_guards: Do not require ROI claims when the offer intentionally avoids outcome claims.

must_inspect.why: Billing units, renewal, cancellation and overage semantics can create decision risk independent of prose quality.
false_positive_guards: Hand legal interpretation off; review only what the artifact communicates.
Do not infer hidden fees from missing detail in a sampled page.
